How it works

Four steps. No sales calls.

1

Build it

Pick the item you want. The surface splits into sticker spots sized to real print dimensions, and you set the starting price on each.

2

Post it live

Your item lands in the live feed instantly, unbranded, with every spot open and the countdown running.

3

Brands buy spots

Brands drop their logo on an open spot and buy it at the exact listed price plus a 20% platform fee. First come, first served, no haggling.

4

It ships branded

At 100% your item ships factory new with the winning sponsors printed as quality die-cut vinyl. Quick photo check-ins keep the deal live for the 12-month term, weekly to monthly depending on the item price.

What the money buys

The exact machine, no mystery.

Every listing shows the real spec and real retail price of the item being funded. Spot prices sum to exactly that price, the 20% platform fee sits on top of each purchase, and the owner receives the item, never cash.

Questions

Asked and answered.

Is this real?
Completely. The items are real, the stickers are real die-cut vinyl, and every listing belongs to a real person who takes it where they work, study, and travel. The only fiction is the idea that a laptop lid or a suitcase isn't premium ad inventory.
Does the owner make money?
No, and that's the point. The owner gets the item itself, shipped new with the sponsors printed on. Spot money funds the item, the 20% fee runs the platform, and nobody is paying strangers cash.
What does a brand actually get?
Your logo printed on the item itself, visible everywhere it goes and in everything its owner posts, plus your spot on the listing page with a link to your site. No impressions promised, just real presence in real rooms your ads can't reach.
How does payment work?
Buying a spot records it at the exact listed price plus a 20% platform fee. You'll get a payment link by email to settle, and money only counts toward the bar once it clears. Spots are first come, first served.
Can any brand join?
Almost. Every sponsor is approved by hand before anything is printed. Alcohol, cannabis, tobacco, and political ads aren't accepted, and the item's owner has the final say on what rides on their stuff. Refused purchases are refunded in full.
What keeps the owner honest?
Photo check-ins. Owners confirm the item and the ads are out in the world on a schedule set by the item's price, weekly for big-ticket items down to monthly for small ones, for a 12-month term. Miss check-ins and payouts pause.
What can I post?
Objects and wearables. Laptops, phones, tumblers, luggage, coolers, wedding suits, graduation gowns. Nothing that needs insurance or permits, so no cars or property.

Your money is held, not handed over

Here's exactly what protects you before you pay.

🔒
Funds sit in escrowStripe holds your payment. The owner never touches cash — it only ever pays for the item itself.
🪪
Owner identity is verifiedBefore any funds move, the owner completes ID verification tied to their real bank account.
📸
12 months of photo check-insThe owner submits proof your logo is still on the item, on the cadence shown on the listing. Miss enough check-ins and your spend is flagged for a refund.
